metadata_path = "/global/u2/r/ritaferi/HADES_DATA/hades-metadata"
db = dbetto.TextDB(metadata_path)

# construct the geometry
reg = pygeomhades.core.construct(
    db.hardware.configuration.V03421A.c1.am_HS1_top_dlt.run0001
)

# visualise
pygeomtools.viewer.visualize(reg)



output_file = (
    "/global/u2/r/ritaferi/HADES_DATA/V03421A/"
    "V03421A_am_HS1_top_dlt_run0001.gdml"
)

writer = gdml.Writer()
writer.addDetector(reg)
writer.write(output_file)

print(f"File GDML creato: {output_file}")
